sources: Built from 111 web searches this run: 109 made by five research passes whose reports I read, 2 by me · AP, NFL.com, Philadelphia Inquirer, philadelphiaeagles.com, buccaneers.com, colts.com, clevelandbrowns.com, RotoWire, CBS Sports, NBC Sports/PFT, Yahoo, SI, Heavy, Athlon, Chicago Sun-Times, BearsTalk, minnesotasportsfan.com (KFAN), The Viking Age, DraftKings Network, FTN, FFToday, FantasyPros, PlayerProfiler, ClutchPoints, 4for4, Yardbarker, Fox Sports, VegasInsider, Dimers, Black and Teal, JetNation, A to Z Sports · carried from Tuesday where nothing newer exists: FootballDB matchup table, Monday's coach quotes · ESPN league file (12:49 UTC 7 Oct), week archives 1–4

tonight.headline: Waivers passed without you, as planned; the lineup is still 9.2 short
body: Bad news first. You are 0–4, and at 07:00 on Wednesday there is still no report behind either of the two receivers the projection lineup needs. Jefferson and McLaurin are both on your bench. As set you project 115.1 against 117.5 and ESPN gives you 49%; the projection lineup is 124.3.

The waiver run processed at 01:00 with no claim from you, which was the recommendation. DK Metcalf went unclaimed and is now a free agent. Today's job is the same two swaps as yesterday, Jefferson for Addison and McLaurin for Kamara, each with the benched man as the fallback. Wednesday's practice reports come out this afternoon, after this brief.

case.label: Their side
case.body: Ja'Marr Chase, their top projection at 21.9, is still in the concussion protocol; an AP story dated 7 Oct says he and Tee Higgins 'may miss' Miami, with no re-evaluation result published. Chuba Hubbard is still in their flex on a bye at 0.0, so their 117.5 rises when they fix it. McBride 18.8, Purdy 18.0, London 16.0, Irving 15.3.

case.label: Your side
case.body: As set: Allen 20.1, Warren 14.6, Wilson 14.6, Tuten 14.0, Likely 12.9, Addison 11.4, Kamara 11.2, Fairbairn 8.5, the Vikings 7.8. No projection on your roster moved overnight. The 9.2 between that and 124.3 depends on two men being active.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Jefferson or McLaurin missing practice through Friday, on your side. Chase being ruled out, on theirs.

tonight.caseSources: ESPN league file · lineup_check.py · AP · Athlon

doFirst.deadlineLabel: Both kick off Sun 11:00 Mexico City · check inactives 09:30
doFirst.title: Jefferson back in for Addison, if he is active
doFirst.subtitle: 18.6 against 11.4, and he is still on your bench. No ruling and no practice yet; the beat writer expects him to 'push to play' and the team to be 'a little bit cautious'. Addison is the fallback.

case.label: What the check says
case.body: As set you project 115.1; the projection lineup is 124.3. Of that 9.2, Jefferson over Addison is 7.2, which the lineup check labels PROJECTION and not a coin flip.

case.label: What is and isn't known
case.body: He sprained an ankle on 27 Sep, missed Week 4 and has not practised since. New since yesterday's brief, and only just: on KFAN on Tuesday, Ben Goessling of the Star Tribune said 'I think he's going to push to play. I think you'll see them be a little bit cautious this week', and Kevin O'Connell said 'He wants to make it back... But we want to be smart' (minnesotasportsfan.com, 6 Oct, 18:47 ET). On Monday O'Connell called it 'a medical thing', tied to whether he can start 'getting some limited work in'. No insider has reported a plan to hold him out through the Week 6 bye, and none has said he plays. Wednesday's practice had not happened when this was written.

case.label: Why set it now
case.body: Because both men play in the same game at 11:00 on Sunday, so nothing locks early and the fallback costs nothing. Setting it today means a missed check leaves 18.6 in the slot if he plays. The risk runs the other way: if he is inactive and you don't look at 09:30, the slot scores zero.

case.label: The dates that matter
case.body: Practice reports this afternoon, Thursday and Friday. A limited session today is the first real evidence since the injury; no practice by Friday means Addison keeps the slot. This afternoon's brief reads the first one.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Jefferson is active and Addison outscores him on Sunday (archive). If he is inactive the card never fires and Addison starts.

doFirst.deadlineLabel: Both kick off Sun 11:00 Mexico City · check inactives 09:30
doFirst.title: Flex: McLaurin over Kamara, if he is active
doFirst.subtitle: 13.2 against 11.2, which the lineup check files as a coin flip. It goes to the projection, with Kamara as the fallback. His coach's promised Wednesday update has not been published yet.

case.label: What the check says
case.body: The other 2.0 of the 9.2. Inside two points ESPN is right 56% of the time, so this gets no thesis and nothing in the decision log.

case.label: What is and isn't known
case.body: McLaurin hurt a hamstring in practice on Fri 2 Oct and was inactive in London. Dan Quinn on Monday: 'I'll give you a better update for him for Wednesday.' That update did not exist at 07:00. The newest report is RotoWire's of 5 Oct, citing John Keim: day-to-day, the team will assess what he can do at Wednesday's practice, and he 'pushed to play' last week. Jayden Daniels is still aiming for a full week of practice and a Sunday start; that too is unconfirmed until he practises.

case.label: Kamara, the fallback
case.body: Two sources now agree on Monday's snaps: Kamara 28, CJ Donaldson 28, Kendre Miller 18 or 19 (Athlon; RotoWire, 6 Oct). RotoWire adds that before garbage time Kamara played 54% of the snaps and had 64% of the backfield's opportunities, so the even split was the blowout. His knee scare on Monday still has no update from the Saints.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: McLaurin is active and Kamara outscores him on Sunday (archive). On a coin flip that happens almost half the time.

whatWentWrong.title: The lineup you have set is still yesterday's, 9.2 under the projection
whatWentWrong.lead: Both cards above were published on Tuesday afternoon. Jefferson and McLaurin are still in bench slots this morning.

case.label: The evidence
case.body: lineup_check.py on the 12:49 UTC file: 115.1 as set, 124.3 for the projection lineup. Jefferson over Addison is 7.2 (PROJECTION); McLaurin over Kamara is 2.0 (COIN FLIP). Neither projection moved overnight.

case.label: What it changes
case.body: Nothing about the advice, and nothing is lost yet: all four play at 11:00 on Sunday. The risk of leaving it is the opposite one from last week. If Jefferson is active and you don't look, 18.6 sits on the bench.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: A report this afternoon that either receiver did not practise. That would not move them out today, but two missed days would.

whatWentWrong.title: The waiver run passed with no claim, and Metcalf cleared
whatWentWrong.lead: Nobody in the league put in for DK Metcalf. He is a free agent this morning, which is what Tuesday's brief was waiting for.

case.label: The evidence
case.body: Activity log, 02:03 Mexico City: Bok-aneers took Tucker Kraft, Footballers took Tyreek Hill, Guillo-tinas took Deshaun Watson and Talla Metralla a kicker. At 06:25 Talla Metralla dropped Trevor Lawrence for T.J. Hockenson. Metcalf is listed FREEAGENT at 12.1.

case.label: What it changes
case.body: Not today's cards. It sets up Thursday: Addison's seat is seven days old then, and if Jefferson has practised, Addison stops being needed as his fallback. Metcalf for Addison is the move that would be on the table, free.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Jefferson not practising today or Thursday. Then Addison is a starter, not a seat, and Metcalf waits again.

report.role: Targets 9 and 4 in his two archived games: 14.6 and 3.8. Tetairoa McMillan caught 14 of 16 targets for 192 yards without him
report.competition: Tetairoa McMillan, and Darren Waller with 6 targets on Sunday
report.checked: Re-checked Wed 7 Oct, 07:00 Mexico City: no injured-reserve move. Schefter (4 Oct, via FTN): Carolina are giving him 'two full weeks to recover'; Canales expects him back after the bye, which is Week 6 at Philadelphia. A CBS headline, 'Won't return Week 6', is dated October 2025 and is ignored. Before that: Yahoo's recap of Canales; RotoWire's profile; CBS, 28 Sep and 5 Oct. OWN_QUESTIONABLE answered: Carolina don't play this week, and the '4–6 games' items a search returns are from 2025
report.summary: On bye and expected back for Week 6, the week Minnesota and Miami are off. His seat isn't the one a Metcalf add uses.

lineupCheck.verdict: The projection lineup is 9.2 above the lineup as set, unchanged since Tuesday: Jefferson over Addison (7.2, PROJECTION) and McLaurin over Kamara in the flex (2.0, a coin flip); both are questionable and both are conditional.

contingencies.then: Start Jordan Addison (11.4) in his WR slot
Start Alvin Kamara (11.2) in his FLEX slot

worthALook.name: DK Metcalf
worthALook.lead: He cleared waivers overnight and is a free agent. Still the receiver to add, and still on Thursday's condition.

case.label: The role
case.body: 5 catches on 9 targets for 115 on Thursday, 16.5 (archive); targets 10, 9, 5, 9. 97% of the snaps and 87% of the routes in Week 4 (RotoWire). No injury. His first three games were 11 catches for 98 yards, so it is one efficient game on steady volume.

case.label: The number that kills it today
case.body: The seat, as on Tuesday. Coker is expected back for Week 6 and Carolina have not put him on injured reserve. Addison's seat is seven days old on Thursday and he is Jefferson's fallback until Jefferson practises. Monangai and Gordon carry open holds; Kamara and Gordon are protected while Etienne and Achane are out.

case.label: When to act
case.body: Thursday, free, for Addison, if Jefferson has practised by then. He has gone unclaimed in this league two weeks running, so one more day is a small risk; a free agent can be taken by anyone at any time, and I can't see who is looking.

worthALook.sources: Week 1–4 archive · RotoWire · ESPN league file · activity log

worthALook.name: Denzel Boston
worthALook.lead: Carried: Metcalf's alternative, on the same condition. Cleveland's 6 Oct depth chart starts him.

case.label: The role
case.body: 4 catches for 89 with a 60-yarder in Week 4, 12.9 (archive); 284 yards and two touchdowns in four games, a Browns rookie record for the opening month (clevelandbrowns.com). About 92% of the routes. Deshaun Watson is the starter.

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: Targets 4, 7, 4, 7 against Metcalf's 10, 9, 5, 9; it is deep-ball efficiency, and KC Concepcion led Cleveland with 8 targets and a 100% route share. You dropped Boston on 1 Oct.

case.label: When to act
case.body: Not this week. Second choice behind Metcalf, and only if Metcalf is gone by Thursday.

worthALook.name: Rico Dowdle
worthALook.lead: Carried, nothing new: the back who takes carries from your Warren when he returns. Still 'TBD' for Sunday.

case.label: The role
case.body: Missed Weeks 3 and 4 with a toe injury. Mike McCarthy: 'a positive workout Friday', 'making progress', a 'one-two punch' with Warren (RotoWire, 5 Oct). With him active Warren took 56% and 55% of the carries; without him, all of them (archive). ESPN lists him QUESTIONABLE.

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: A handcuff to a back you start, on a roster with five backs and no free seat. He ran 15 times for 37 yards before the injury.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Nothing makes him an add here. His practice status this afternoon matters for Warren's number, not for your roster.

doNotChase.name: Will Shipley
doNotChase.lead: The biggest riser on the wire this morning, at 10.3. Still a sixth back for you.

case.label: The rise
case.body: Tank Bigsby went on injured reserve officially on Tuesday evening and Saquon Barkley has no ruling yet; Nick Sirianni promised 'more answers... probably Wednesday'. Shipley is the only healthy back on Philadelphia's 53. No back was signed or elevated in Tuesday's transaction, though it opened a practice-squad place.

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: 6 carries for 23 on 47% of the snaps: 2.3 (archive); 15 carries all season. 10.3 is below all five of your backs, the Inquirer names three practice-squad backs who may be elevated, and Jacksonville allow the second-fewest standard points to running backs.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Barkley ruled out for a month, and one of your backs ruled out with him.

doNotChase.sources: Philadelphia Inquirer · RotoWire · Yahoo · Week 4 archive · FootballDB

doNotChase.name: Cowboys D/ST
doNotChase.lead: The highest-projected free defence, 0.9 above yours, and FantasyPros' number one for the week.

case.label: The rise
case.body: Dallas host Tampa Bay on Thursday as 8.5-point favourites. Todd Bowles confirmed Jalon Daniels, an undrafted rookie, starts again; Baker Mayfield did not practise Monday or Tuesday. FantasyPros ranks Dallas 1st, RotoWire 4th, NBC 9th.

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: 8.7 against the Vikings' 7.8, and the same three lists rank Minnesota 2nd, 7th and 2nd. Under a point isn't a streaming move. FantasyPros also notes Dallas are last in fantasy scoring among defences so far.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Nothing this week. Next Tuesday you need a defence for Minnesota's bye, and Dallas play at Green Bay in Week 6.

doNotChase.sources: ESPN league file · FantasyPros · RotoWire · NBC Sports · buccaneers.com

doNotChase.name: Joe Mixon
doNotChase.lead: Still rising on the wire with no team, and Tuesday night's report says why Seattle walked away.

case.label: The rise
case.body: Monday's reports had him joining Seattle's practice squad. Monday's waiver columns still say so.

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: Seattle passed after his physical found 'a degenerative foot issue that could wind up putting a premature end to his NFL career' (FTN, 6 Oct, 20:01 ET). No team since. He missed all of 2025 and has no projection.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: A signing to a 53-man roster and a coach describing a role.

doNotChase.name: Malik Washington
doNotChase.lead: Carried: Yahoo's receiver add of the week, in an offence that threw for 85 yards.

case.label: The rise
case.body: 5 catches on 5 targets for 67, 12.0 (archive); target shares of 28% and 29% in the last two weeks and 86% of the snaps in three of four games (Yahoo, 5 Oct).

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: Targets 8, 5, 10, 5 from Malik Willis, who was 9 of 17 for 85. Miami are off in Week 6, the same week as your Vikings.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Eight or more targets against Cincinnati, or a different quarterback in Miami.

doNotChase.name: Makai Lemon
doNotChase.lead: Carried: six targets with Smith out, in an offence that threw for 93 yards.

case.label: The rise
case.body: DeVonta Smith (hamstring) is expected to miss multiple games (Inquirer, 5–6 Oct). Lemon played 45 of 61 snaps.

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: 3 catches on 6 targets for 27, 5.7 (archive), and no more than 30 yards in any game. Darius Cooper played 55 snaps and caught both touchdowns.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Eight or more targets in London.

doNotChase.sources: Week 4 archive · NBC Sports Philadelphia · Philadelphia Inquirer · CBS Sports

waiverAnalysis.summary: The same four receivers clear the tool's bar as on Tuesday, and the bar is still partly an artefact: it measures them against Coker, whose last two weeks are an injury and a missed game. Four weeks of data. Nothing reported overnight gives any of them a role reason to act on, and nothing clears at running back or tight end.

rising.name: Romeo Doubs
rising.roleReason: 6 catches on 9 targets with two touchdowns against Buffalo, a 25% share, after Mack Hollins left with a calf strain; Vrabel doesn't know if Hollins can practise 'for a couple days'. A.J. Brown is on injured reserve and eligible in Week 6, but DraftKings Network projects about Week 8. Rostered in your other league overnight.
rising.action: WATCH — one nine-target game, with the team's best receiver eligible to return in a week

rising.name: Dohnte Meyers
rising.roleReason: 7 catches on 9 targets after Ja'Marr Chase (concussion) and Tee Higgins (adductor) left. Both are still day-to-day; AP (7 Oct) says they 'may miss' Miami and names Meyers and Mitchell Tinsley as next up. Cincinnati are off in Week 6.
rising.action: WATCH — the role exists only if Chase and Higgins both sit

rising.name: Khalil Shakir
rising.roleReason: 7 catches on 8 targets for 82 in the game DJ Moore left with an aggravated AC joint. Moore has no practice status yet; Keon Coleman, 6 for 116 on 78% of the snaps, is the Bill the columns prefer and the one whose ownership jumped 19 points.
rising.action: WATCH — depends on Moore missing Monday night, and Coleman is ahead of him for the extra targets

rising.name: KC Concepcion
rising.roleReason: The steadiest of the four: a team-high 8 targets and a 100% route share in Week 4, and a listed starter on Cleveland's 6 Oct depth chart with Jeudy and Boston. The volume is real and the production isn't yet: 7.6 a game.
rising.action: WATCH — a real role at 7.6 points a game; behind Metcalf if a seat opens on Thursday

settled.title: 'No claim tonight' (both of Tuesday's briefs)
settled.result: The run processed at 01:00 with no claim from you. Metcalf went unclaimed and is free; Coker has no injured-reserve move. Nothing was lost by waiting. Whether passing was right is graded when the seat question is answered on Thursday.

settled.title: 'Set Jefferson for Addison and McLaurin for Kamara today' (Tuesday afternoon)
settled.result: Not done yet: both are still on the bench this morning. No points are at stake until Sunday; the cards are carried.

settled.title: Kamara in the flex once McLaurin and Coker were out (the contingency, 2–4 Oct)
settled.result: Archive: Kamara 22.8, but Monangai, still unlocked when the swap was made, scored 28.0. Closed WRONG by 5.2, as its own falsifier said.

settled.title: 'Start Kamara in the flex; bench Coker' (Sunday morning's brief)
settled.result: Coker was inactive and scored 0; Kamara scored 22.8 (archive). Closed RIGHT.

settled.title: If Jefferson is inactive, add Addison and start him (30 Sep)
settled.result: It fired. Archive: Addison 9.1, Kamara 22.8. The falsifier named Kamara, so it closes WRONG. Boston, the player you dropped for him, scored 12.9.

settled.title: Dropping Kyle Pitts on usage (22 Sep)
settled.result: Archive: Likely beat him 3.3 to 1.5 and 13.6 to 7.7, so the two-of-three clause can't fire. His snap share was 59% in Week 3 and I could not get a figure for Monday; PFF says 'typical 2026 levels'. Closed RIGHT on the scores.

settled.title: Tuten in the RB slot over the bench backs (the projection lineup)
settled.result: Archive: Tuten 11.1, Monangai 28.0, Gordon 18.0. No brief overrode the projection; the projection lost.

settled.title: 'Fairbairn is 0.5 better; under a point isn't a move' (Sunday morning's brief)
settled.result: You made the swap. Archive: Fairbairn 16, Pineiro 5. The hold closed WRONG by 11.

settled.title: 'Monangai is not the drop until the thumb is known' (4–5 Oct)
settled.result: Still 'day to day' and 'going to be OK' on Tuesday. The hold stands and his seat stays closed.

settled.title: 'The claim turns on whether Jefferson is ruled out on Tuesday' (Monday's brief)
settled.result: He wasn't, and nothing was published either way. No claim was made.

settled.title: Claim Gordon for Achane: 'under 12 touches in Week 4 means a timeshare' (28 Sep)
settled.result: He had 11 touches, so it closed WRONG as written, and scored 18.0. The clause was badly written; the claim gained.

cannotSee.label: Wednesday's practice reports
cannotSee.body: None existed at 07:00. Minnesota, Washington, Chicago, Pittsburgh and New Orleans publish this afternoon; Buffalo's first is later in the week. Everything in this brief about Jefferson, McLaurin, Monangai, Dowdle and Kamara is Monday's or Tuesday's reporting.

cannotSee.label: How little is new
cannotSee.body: Five research passes found almost nothing dated after Tuesday 18:00 ET. For your roster the only newer items are two radio quotes on Jefferson and a second source on New Orleans' snap counts. Most rows therefore read 'no change', and that is the finding.

cannotSee.label: Rival claims and adds
cannotSee.body: ESPN returns only your own claims. Four rivals claimed players at 02:03 and one swapped at 06:25. Metcalf is a free agent and anyone can add him at any minute; I can't see who is considering it.

cannotSee.label: Jefferson and the bye
cannotSee.body: No reporter has said Minnesota will hold him out through the Week 6 bye and none has said he plays. 'A little bit cautious this week' is a beat writer's read, not a team statement.

cannotSee.label: Matchup grades
cannotSee.body: Carried from Tuesday's FootballDB full-PPR table rather than re-read today; no game has been played since, so the ranks are the same. RotoWire's description of Cleveland's corners still contradicts the points-allowed rank for Garrett Wilson.

cannotSee.label: Betting lines
cannotSee.body: Lines come from one page each and the pages disagree by half a point to a point. Chicago as a road favourite with a backup quarterback rests on a page with no timestamp.

cannotSee.label: A snap count I couldn't re-confirm
cannotSee.body: The 36-to-15 split for Tuten and Rodriguez still rests on one NBC Sports page. Kamara's 28 snaps are now confirmed by two sources.

cannotSee.label: The wire screen
cannotSee.body: Jaylen Wright, Isaiah Williams, Antonio Williams, Oronde Gadsden and Cade Otton aren't on the published wire, so their availability in this league is the screen's inference that nobody rosters them. Only Wright, Michael Mayer and Otton were new to the screen and researched today; the other verdicts are carried from Tuesday and say so.

cannotSee.label: Reports I couldn't retrieve
cannotSee.body: ESPN's article and injury pages, vikings.com's injury report, the Washington Times piece on Jaylin Lane, NBC Sports' Week 5 injury report (6 Oct, 20:26 ET) and RotoBaller's items returned no article body. Pages were read through a summarising tool, so quotes are close but may not be exact.

cannotSee.label: The trade market
cannotSee.body: No trade this run. Three receivers have unknown timelines, and anything offered would be priced on guesses. The window the strategy names is Weeks 9 to 11.

cannotSee.label: Next week
cannotSee.body: Minnesota and Miami are both off in Week 6: Jefferson, Addison, the Vikings' defence and Gordon. That is the main reason Coker's return and Thursday's look at Metcalf matter.
